scientific_review: One bounded30x590 GEBCO2026 elevation/TID tile covers the407-profile ADCP crossing and circular footprint envelopes. Elevation and TID coordinates and pixel registration are checked. Complete small ASCII responses and hashes are retained for independent reproduction; all source-field processing ran in cloud.

Seven native samples are deeper than nearest GEBCO point-grid bed estimates. This is a mismatch against the gridded product, not proof that ship measurements were physically beneath the actual seabed.

Point-bed-only screening excludes21 velocity samples; point85percent sidelobe screening excludes194; circular-footprint85percent screening excludes240. Masks apply to native rows before spatial selection/smoothing. Counts are source-level screening diagnostics, not counts of independently proven bad observations.

Manufacturer specifies30degree beams; UHDAS/GO-SHIP guidance excludes roughly bottom15percent. The implemented6m draft and8m support margin are explicit scenarios. Gridded depths, nominal MSL datum, grid-cell allowance and circular beam envelope do not replace ship bottom tracking, beam-specific range, tides, motion, subgrid terrain or original cruise QC.

At25km, all tested masks/PG retain offshore maximum40.44m. Unmasked or bed-only inshore PG50/70 gives288.44m; point-sidelobe screen gives168.44m and footprint screen200.44m. Screening can change the contributing samples and averages, so maxima need not shift monotonically shallower. These are sensitivity results, not confidence bounds or a verified explanation of source prose/Table3 differences.

All27 cases remain conditional branch scenarios. No new bottom, thickness, annual depth range or volume is admitted. Tide correction, beam-bottom masking and source branch limits still need independent verification before canonical derived measurement admission.

Six screening tests plus nine frozen branch-scenario tests pass in cloud. They verify separate bed/sidelobe limits, support margins and equality, footprint shallowing, unknown preservation, ASCII dimensions/coordinates, nearest-cell selection, signed smoothing, gaps, station revisits and candidate maximum semantics. Existing registers, previous scenarios and source comparisons are preserved.
